merged.title: feat(port): add shared typed materials and Material Studio
merged.author: pezzadev
merged.untrustedBody:
Mesh slots now reference reusable named materials. Editing a shared definition updates every linked surface; making an independent copy separates it. Material Studio exposes Lit, Glass Lit, Lit Fur Surface, Lit Wet Fur Surface, Lit Foliage and Original, with inherited controls shown without saving untouched defaults.

The renderer shares equivalent surface records and stores optical parameters in the Vulkan material table. Glass retains authored cutout coverage, Original restores linked retail chrome packets, and preparation fingerprints account for material types that change transport. Authored Novalis, Kerwan and Eudora NTSC profiles ship through the normal export/bake flow.

The cleanup separates Studio navigation, property widgets, preview ownership, chrome preparation and surface GPU tests. Verified ship layouts are selected by the RAC1 game profile instead of shared frontend game checks. Separate fixes declare probe-sphere graph resources and keep the window responsive during loa

merged.title: fix(regress): trace frames that keep the last picture
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** a frame where the game sends nothing new keeps the last picture, and the trace got no line for it. Gaspar's standard route ends on such a frame, so the runner saw 658 of 660 frames after control and marked the run "exit".

**After:** Gaspar is "ok". Every window frame has a trace line.

**How:** `keep_picture` writes a trace line with the last tick's values and `k: 1`. Trace comparisons skip those lines. Docs updated.

**Tested:** container, rac1 NTSC, software GL, render_scale=25. Gaspar was "exit" before the fix and is "ok" after it. Full standard set: 19/19 ok. `test_regress` passes 40/40, with 2 new tests. Not tested on a GPU or on PAL.

merged.title: fix(launcher): mods and saves come in with the page; new README pictures
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before**
The README GIF and the launcher screenshots (README Mods picture, launcher/README game and Mods pictures) showed the old launcher look. Switching tabs also had a glitch: on the first visit to Mods the mod list was read after the slide took its picture, so the updates panel showed in its place for a moment and the rows popped in. On later visits the kept rows stayed hidden until the list was read again. Games did the same with saves ("Reading the memory card…" during the slide from Settings).

**After**
The README GIF is recorded from the current launcher, with the same steps, size and speed (1440x900, 20 fps, about 33 s, 3.1 MB). The three screenshots are taken again at their old sizes. Mods and saves come in with the page, so a tab switch is a clean fade.

**How**
- `motion.ts`: `holdSlide()` lets a page make its slide wait up to 300 ms for a first read.
- `PluginsPanel` and `SaveManagerBlock` use it when nothing is kept yet. Kept rows show at once. Saves and found updates

merged.title: feat: SVG and KTX2 pictures in texture packs, kept compressed on the GPU
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
## Before
Texture packs read only PNGs, and every replacement took RGBA8 on the GPU.

## After
- Packs may also hold SVG (drawn at 4x the texture's size, for sharp HUD icons, text and logos) and KTX2.
- KTX2 may be Basis Universal (UASTC or ETC1S) or plain RGBA8. Formats only some GPUs read (BC1-BC7, ASTC, ETC2 in the file) are refused, so a pack works on every platform.
- Basis KTX2 is transcoded at load to what the GPU reads: BC7, else ASTC 4x4, else RGBA8. It is uploaded with the file's mip levels, so it takes about a quarter of the GPU memory.
- When a texture has several pictures, the game uses SVG first, then KTX2, then PNG. A file that cannot be read falls back to the next one.
- The launcher checks SVG and KTX2 on import, counts a texture once across kinds, and merges, exports and gives hints for the new kinds.

## How
- `renderer/textures/pack_pictures` holds the decoders: Basis Universal 2.50 for the transcoder and zstd, and nanosvg.
- `TexturePool::set_blocks` and `gpu_block

merged.title: fix(rac1): carry the boot memory card wrap and new hooks to NTSC-J and PAL v1
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** rac1-jp and rac1-pal1 failed to build on develop. boot.c calls `func_00209BB8__game`, but these releases had no wrap row for CheckBootMemoryCard. They also missed the GoldBolts_CountUnspent and Vendor_OpenMenu hooks and the new HUD wrap names.

**After:** both releases build. They get the boot memory card wrap and the two mod hooks, same as PAL and NTSC-U.

**How:**
- Add the missing rows to libraries.tsv and host/rac1_names.tsv, as release_rac1.py writes them (JP func_0020AAE0, PAL v1 func_00208C38 for the memory card check).
- The sky routine stays left out on these discs. Its omit moves from a hand edit of rac1_version.h to release.json, and release_rac1.py now drops table rows of host C a release leaves out. Before, a new carry would wrap the sky routine with no host function and break the link.
- JP's Aridia omit and PAL v1's Aridia anchors also move to release.json, so a new carry keeps them.

**Tested:** hostgen (--asm off) for rac1-jp and rac1-pal1, then clang -fsyn

merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** the game's own Video page (rac1 and rac2, title and pause menu) kept its own long list of port settings, separate from the in-game menu. The two drifted apart, and the page showed 4 to 7 of about 24 rows at a time.

**Tested:** rac1 and rac2 title and pause Video pages in the container: scrolling, 4:3 hiding the HUD row, touch screen hiding Display mode, German labels, and each new row changing and saving. `menu_catalog`, `settings`,

merged.title: fix(hdr): stop SDR hue from banding on pale SDR colours
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
## Before

With SDR Hue up, smooth effects showed sudden bands of orange and pink (the metal detector's rings up close). Where SDR shows a colour pale, its hue swings a lot with each 8-bit step of the picture, and that hue got the full strength of the HDR colour.

## After

The bands are gone or much weaker. The largest colour change between neighbouring 8-bit steps drops from 0.042 to 0.014 (OKLab); plain HDR is 0.003. Flames keep their SDR yellow to the core. Default settings are unchanged.

## How

- `sdr_hue_of` scales the pixel until its lowest channel is at 0.4 (was 0.8), so the hue comes from a stronger colour.
- A pale SDR hue turns a much stronger HDR colour only in part (`kSureHueShare`).
- Same in `hdr_encode.comp`.

## Tested

- `hdr` (new test: neighbouring 8-bit steps stay close; it fails on the old code) and `vulkan_hdr` (GPU against CPU) pass; conventions pass.
- Synthetic metal-detector rings (a pale pink 8-bit sprite added up 1 to 6 times over a ground, three colour s

merged.title: fix(launcher): send job output in batches so the window stays responsive
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** every output line of a job was its own event to the page. Each event runs on the launcher's main thread, so a chatty program (the game, the Enhanced lighting baker) froze the window: no navigation, Cancel did not react, and queued lines kept showing after the game had closed. This hit every platform; on Android it hit the baker (the game runs in its own activity there).

**After:** the window stays responsive while the game or the baker runs, Cancel works, and the log stops when the program ends.

**How:** core `jobs::batched` sends a job's lines about ten times a second, at most 1000 per batch (older ones dropped with a note), then the exit. Lines written after the exit by a left-behind process are dropped. The page adds each batch in one change (`Queue.applyAll`). `cancel_job` is now async, so Windows' taskkill does not block the main thread.

**Tested:** cargo test (2 tests fail on develop too: they need the decomp submodules), cargo clippy -D warnings, yarn verify, new

merged.title: fix(launcher): keep the game marked in the Games list while the next tab loads
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** On desktop, pressing Mods from a game's page made the Games list drop its mark while the Mods page loaded and slid in. The open disc shrank and turned back, then the Mods list showed it marked again.

**After:** The Games list keeps its game marked until the Mods page replaces it. The disc stays still.

**How:** GameList marks `app.version`'s game on every page except the library, not only on the game page. The old list stays on screen during the slide, after `app.page` has already changed.

**Tested:** `yarn verify` and `yarn test:android` pass. In the browser preview, the Games list kept its mark on every check from the press until Mods came in (before: lost it at once). Not tested on macOS WebKit or Windows WebView2.

merged.title: fix(launcher): keep the update dialog's main button gold under the pointer
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** in the update dialog, hovering the main button ("Try again", "Update and restart", or "Download from GitHub" when it is the main one) turned it into a dark control fill with dark text. The label was nearly unreadable in every theme, worst in OLED.

**After:** the button turns gold under the pointer, like every other main button in the launcher.

**How:** the shared button hover in app.css sets a dark background and wins over the dialog's own amber fill. The dialog's hover now sets the gold fill itself instead of only a brightness filter.

**Tested:** yarn verify and yarn test:android pass. Hovered the button in the browser preview in all four themes (openrac, OLED, Nord, Mocha), failed-update and download-only cases. Not tested in the built desktop app.

merged.title: feat(pal,us2): match the PAL and USA v2.00 copies of func_002DC3C8
merged.author: Fromnowheree
merged.untrustedBody:
## What

Matches 2 functions: the PAL and USA v2.00 copies of `func_002DC3C8`, the timed text page controller matched for USA v1.01 in #451.

| Function | Release | Catalogued entry | Placements |
|---|---|---|---|
| `func_PAL_002DD0C0` | PAL | `002DD0C0` → `002DD0C8`, 848 bytes | boot and 27 levels |
| `func_US2_002DD0F8` | USA v2.00 | `002DD0F8` → `002DD100`, 848 bytes | boot and 27 levels |

- **Same instructions, other constants.** Both disassemble instruction for instruction like v1.01's copy; only immediates differ:
  - PAL: text ids 0x16CC lower (`0x33C0` → `0x1CF4`, ...), and 50 Hz page times: 150, 200 and 250 frames where v1.01 waits 180, 240 and 300.
  - USA v2.00: text ids 0xB8 higher (`0x33C0` → `0x3478`, ...); times unchanged.
- **Same entry.** Both begin with the 8-byte residue #451 measured in v1.01 (`sw $zero, 0x50($a0); nop`), so each gets the same named `FUNCTION_ENTRY_OFFSETS` row, `(856, 8)`. `tools/carry.py --version pal --entries` and `--version us2 --entries` cha

Two functions, 6,824 bytes: the USA v2.00 and PAL copies of the level 04/11 race-challenge panel. Both are plain C with no compiler switches, each in a unit of its own (`-O2 -G8 -ffunction-sections -g`, like the other HUD panels). They are checked against my discs, whose SHA-256s are the ones in `docs/build/versions.md`.

| Function | Bytes | Places | Unit |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `func_US2_L04_0040C224` | 3384 | 2 | `src/us2/levels/shared/L04_0040C224-panel-g8.c` |
| `func_PAL_L04_0040F2AC` | 3440 | 2 | `src/pal/levels/shared/L04_0040F2AC-panel-g8.c` |

merged.title: fix(archipelago): allow ammo drops for owned out-of-order weapons
merged.author: SavedbyBlood9
merged.untrustedBody:
Archipelago can grant a starting weapon before its normal planet, but ammo selection still reads the retail vendor stock. Add an Ammo_ChooseDrop hook that temporarily supplies a terminated list of owned ammo-supporting weapons, then restores the real stock.

The retail selector still handles assigned first-break ammo, low-ammo priority, pickup count and the Bomb Glove fallback. Add PAL/NTSC selector-spy regression coverage for out-of-order weapons, exclusion of unowned/non-ammo items, argument/output passthrough and stock restoration. Register the hook, document the behavior and bump the mod to 2.3.1.

Validation: Windows x64 Release build; all 12 Archipelago CTest cases passed. Tests use the simulated host and do not execute the retail selector; in-game verification remains.

merged.title: fix(item-randomizer): select ammo from all owned ammo weapons
merged.author: SavedbyBlood9
merged.untrustedBody:
RAC1 ammo drops currently borrow the vendor-menu stock, which can omit an owned weapon received before its normal planet. Build the ammo selector's temporary stock directly from all owned ammo-supporting weapons instead, retaining a terminator and restoring the real vendor stock afterward.

Keep the existing rando_on gate so saves outside this seed use the unmodified selector.
